description: Land Acquisition - Kaluganga, Dewaledeniya, Laggala D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project. It contains detailed notices under the Land Acquisition Act describing specific land parcels, their locations, extents, claimants, and possessors. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), with no government personnel changes or structural modifications mentioned.
